ko: 구주의 십자가 보혈로 죄 씻음 받기를 원하네
내 죄를 씻으신 주 이름 찬송합시다
en: Down at the cross where my Saviour died, where for clean-sing from sin I cried There to my heart was the blood applied Glory to His name
